recognize_zh: 周邊血片中一個大型細胞，核圓形偏於一側、有一個清楚的核仁，細胞質豐富且呈均勻深藍色，為帶有核仁的未成熟漿細胞樣細胞（plasmablastic 型）；只顯示單一細胞，無法判斷是否達到漿細胞白血病的比例。
features: Single large cell with abundant homogeneous deep blue cytoplasm
Round, eccentrically placed nucleus occupying about half of the cell
Finely granular to moderately condensed chromatin with a single distinct nucleolus (immature/plasmablastic features)
No cytoplasmic granules; perinuclear hof not clearly seen
Background red cells with rouleaux-like aggregation, refractile debris and a weakly stained preparation
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single large cell with an eccentric round nucleus containing a distinct nucleolus and abundant homogeneous deep blue cytoplasm, consistent with an immature circulating plasma cell. Background red cells show rouleaux-like stacking and refractile artifacts limit evaluation. Because only one cell is shown, the proportion of circulating plasma cells cannot be determined from this image. In a myeloma patient with leukocytosis, a differential count showing ≥5% circulating clonal plasma cells supports plasma cell leukemia; flow cytometry (CD38/CD138, light-chain restriction) is recommended.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts have a central nucleus, less abundant and less basophilic cytoplasm, may have granules/Auer rods and are CD34/CD117 positive rather than CD138 positive.
Immunoblasts are polytypic and seen with other reactive lymphocytes during infection, lacking a monotypic plasma cell population.
Morphology overlaps; the absence of a myeloma history and presence of EBV/MYC rearrangement favor plasmablastic lymphoma.
